data.name: SettingsLanguageAutomatic
data.comment: Settings, the Language row: its first choice, beside each language in its own name (ENGLISH, DEUTSCH). Upper case, as every choice in settings.

data.name: SettingsLanguageAutomaticTip
data.value: The game's language, else Windows', else English
data.comment: Settings, the Language row: tooltip of AUTOMATIC. Only a language Shturmap is fully translated into counts.

data.name: SettingsLanguageInTranslation
data.comment: Settings, the Language row, developer builds only: a language whose translation isn't finished. {language}: its own name in upper case, DEUTSCH.

data.name: SettingsLanguageInTranslationTip
data.value: Developer builds only: not every text is translated yet; the rest shows in English.
data.comment: Settings, the Language row, developer builds only: tooltip of a language whose translation isn't finished.

data.name: SettingsLanguageFromGame
data.comment: Settings, the note under the Language row: what AUTOMATIC comes to, the game's language. {language}: that language's own name, Deutsch.

data.name: SettingsLanguageFromWindows
data.comment: Settings, the note under the Language row: what AUTOMATIC comes to, Windows' display language (the game's is unknown or not translated). {language}: that language's own name, Deutsch.

data.name: SettingsLanguageNeither
data.value: Automatic: {language}. Neither the game's nor Windows' language is translated yet.
data.comment: Settings, the note under the Language row: what AUTOMATIC comes to when Shturmap has no translation for the game's or Windows' language. {language}: English's own name, English.
